---
title: "Programming & Computing"
---

Notes on the tools used throughout this site — R, Python, SQL, reproducible
workflows, and version control.

Planned areas:

- R — fundamentals, data manipulation, functions, iteration, ggplot2, testing
- Python — fundamentals, NumPy, pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn
- Structured Query Language (SQL) — [foundations](sql-fundamentals.qmd), joins,
  aggregation, common table expressions (CTEs), window functions
- Reproducible workflows — targets, project structure, renv, pipeline design
- Git & GitHub — fundamentals, commits, branches, merge/rebase, pull requests, Actions
- Command line — shell basics, files, pipes, scripts
